authority: Declared device and memory policy for the isolated GPU cohort; resource limits are part of the recorded execution protocol.

neural_training.workers_selection: 4 only if isolated pilot host RAM <4GiB; otherwise reduce. No CPU neural workers.
before_launch: CUDA model/observation tensors verified on device
free memory and unrelated existing jobs
neural_training.cohort_policy: 100 GPU long configurations start fresh; original680 CPU150 retained as independent prefix cohort; interrupted CPU-long remains excluded trace. No CPU/GPU trajectory splice.

host_protection.action_if_resource_limit_fails: Stop affected job, retain exception/checkpoints, diagnose before retry; never switch silently to CPU or increase memory cap.
